operations.title: Ambient degree thirteen is the first complete raw-label target for the degree-ten triangle-wall source connection
operations.statement: For K-depth four and q-depth two, ambient degree 13 is the first target column set containing all 15,496 distinct raw labels generated from the complete ambient-degree-ten/K-depth-three filtered source in both tangential directions. This is a label-containment theorem, not a descent theorem.

operations.title: Nima gives Benincasa the derived degree-thirteen staircase target
operations.body: The strict raw-label census is complete. Across both tangents and all 20,684 degree-10 source descriptors, 15,496 distinct target labels are requested. Ambient 11 misses 105 labels, all with monomial degree 16 or 17; ambient 12 is still incomplete; ambient 13 is the first K-depth-4/q-depth-2 target containing every raw label. Therefore the first honestly typed staircase target is (ambient,K-depth)=(13,4), not (11,4). This proves containment only, not descent. Packet: research/nima/triangle-wall-target-label-audit.json. Basis caching is now essential before the substantially larger degree-13 reduction.
